newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy blue-chip index starts at record high.
newsitem.headline: Italy blue-chip index starts at record high.

text.p: Italy's blue-chip Mib30 stock index opened more than one percent higher at a fresh record peak of 19718 early on Thursday and continued rising.
The index peaked at 19837 before slipping back to stand 0.93 percent up at 19794.
The all-share Mibtel index also rallied, hitting a new historical high of 13,095 after the opening.
On Wednesday the Mib30 index ended 1.98 percent firmer at a record high of 19,612 while the all-share Mibtel index closed 1.67 percent up at 12,930, just off a session high at 12,931.
The June contract of the Fib30 bourse futures opened at a peak earlier on Thursday of 19,785.
Dealers said the stock market gains were due to a rally in the Italian bond market, which in turn was driven by optimism on European convergence.
